data.title: Hydroquinone 2% (and 4%)
data.summary: VIII Pigmentary / depigmenting · Phenolic tyrosinase inhibitor (hydroxyphenol); gold-standard depigmenting agent
data.body:
_Topicals · VIII Pigmentary / depigmenting_

**Class:** Phenolic tyrosinase inhibitor (hydroxyphenol); gold-standard depigmenting agent

## Mechanism of action
- Competitive substrate inhibitor of tyrosinase → less melanin
- Also generates reactive oxygen species that damage melanosomes and melanocytes (cytotoxic)
- Unstable — oxidises to brown (do not use if the cream turns brown)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Melasma (first-line, alone 2–4% or in triple combination), PIH, solar lentigines, ephelides
- Monobenzone (monobenzyl ether of hydroquinone) is different — causes permanent depigmentation (used for universal vitiligo)

## Dose & formulations
- Apply at night to pigmented areas only; with strict daytime broad-spectrum sunscreen
- Use for 3–4 months, then take a break (cycling) or switch to non-hydroquinone maintenance (azelaic acid, kojic acid, niacinamide)
- 2% available OTC in some countries; 4% prescription

## Adverse effects
- Irritant and allergic contact dermatitis
- Transient hypopigmentation, 'halo' effect around treated areas, confetti-like depigmentation
- Exogenous ochronosis (blue-black pigmentation, caviar-like papules) — especially with long-term use, high concentrations and in dark skin (common in Africa with unregulated products)
- Nail discolouration

## Contraindications
- Pregnancy and breastfeeding (avoid; significant absorption 35–45%)
- Hypersensitivity; sunburnt or inflamed skin

## Drug interactions
- Benzoyl peroxide and hydrogen peroxide: transient dark staining

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid in pregnancy (old FDA category C; high absorption).

## Viva points
- Tyrosinase inhibitor + melanocytotoxic
- Exogenous ochronosis with prolonged use
- Monobenzone (not hydroquinone) for permanent depigmentation
- Banned in cosmetics in the EU; prescription-only in many countries

_Sources: Khopkar ch.26 (Demelanizing agents); Wolverton 4e ch.57. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
